text: Concurrency attacks: simultaneous debits cannot overspend, one request pays once, same-key stampede has one effect, two settlements cannot drain one wallet, 50 in-flight reads no 5xx (attacks/stage-1/test_concurrency.py)

Repetition/ordering attacks: key boundaries, replay identity, changed-body 409, 4xx key reuse, claimed key beats invalid body, scoping, decline/cancel twice, split and settlement replay (attacks/stage-1/test_idempotency.py)

Balance/conservation attacks: exact drain then block, failed pay no trace, request over balance, short pay then fund, negative reset 422 unchanged, feed visibility, note verbatim/length, amount forms/range, 2^53 exactness, minor_units (attacks/stage-1/test_balance.py)

Boundary attacks: split rounding table/order/zero-share/sole-caller, pagination bounds and bad integer query forms, signup handle derivation/truncation/conflicts, bad tokens (attacks/stage-1/test_boundaries.py)

Durability attacks: export shape, round trip preserves balances/tokens/receipts/timestamps, repeated import idempotent, read-only snapshot, invalid import 422 unchanged, reset clears imported state (attacks/stage-1/test_durability.py)

Settlement attacks: collective net-zero batch on empty wallets must commit, collective insufficiency atomic, entry-error precedence, size 1/32/33, response order/linkage, operator permission does not leak private data (attacks/stage-1/test_settlement.py)

Request lifecycle attacks: wrong-party pay/decline/cancel 403, unknown request 404, decline/cancel after terminal state 409, replay body identity, direction/status filters and newest-first listing, auth required on wallets (attacks/stage-1/test_requests.py)
Targeted regression: paying an already-paid request with a NEW key must be 409 request_not_pending (not 200), and a non-list settlements transfers batch must be 422 validation_failed (not 400)

Holds and wallet fields: balance=total, available=total-held; hold moves no money and stays out of the feed; idempotent authorize and key reuse; insufficient_funds judged on available; self_payment and validation table; seeded-hold derivation and over-balance reset 422 changing nothing; TTL 600 default/custom/invalid; seeded and clock expiry release without a wall-clock request (attacks/stage-2/test_holds.py)

Capture and void: full/partial final capture releases the remainder; final:false keeps it; cumulative captured_amount/payment_ids/remaining_amount; over-remaining 422; byte-exact replay body; idempotent capture moves money once; receiver-only capture, payer-only void; expired/voided/closed errors; list scope, filters and pagination (attacks/stage-2/test_capture.py)

Concurrency: 24-way full-capture stampede moves money once; 30-way partial captures never exceed the authorization; 40-way holds never overspend available; payment/hold race; capture/void race serialisable; total and non-negative available at every read under mixed load (attacks/stage-2/test_concurrency2.py)

Content negotiation and routes: every required route reachable; /requests and /authorizations serve HTML for Accept text/html and JSON otherwise; JSON endpoints unaffected by a text/html Accept (attacks/stage-2/test_ui_api.py)

Browser UI races (Chromium): unchanged pay-form resubmit does not double-pay; lost response shows pay-uncertain then a same-key retry moves money once; remote spend shows pay-error and refreshes with inputs kept; remote cancel drops the stale pay button; post-action list refresh; wallet-refresh latest-wins over a delayed read; authorization testids, available headline and permitted capture/void controls (attacks/stage-2/test_ui_race.py)

Stage-1 upgrade and hold durability: a stage-1-shaped export imports; the session survives; pending requests stay payable; a lost payment retries to the original payment; a hold survives a snapshot and stays capturable (attacks/stage-2/test_upgrade.py)
